# Awesome Agent Trading

> Curated directory of AI trading agents and tools for US equities and options, global crypto and DeFi, and prediction markets.

## Resources

- Searchable directory: https://laplace0x.github.io/awesome-agent-trading/
- Jev trading guide: https://laplace0x.github.io/awesome-agent-trading/jev-trading/
- Jev trading machine-readable summary: https://laplace0x.github.io/awesome-agent-trading/jev-trading/llms.txt
- Downloadable directory data: https://laplace0x.github.io/awesome-agent-trading/projects.json
- Repository: https://github.com/laplace0x/awesome-agent-trading
- Full directory: https://github.com/laplace0x/awesome-agent-trading/blob/main/README.md
- Featured data subset: https://github.com/laplace0x/awesome-agent-trading/blob/main/data/projects.json
- Contribution criteria: https://github.com/laplace0x/awesome-agent-trading/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

## Categories

- Trading Agents: agent decision and execution systems; experimental and source-available projects are labeled.
- Jev Trading: early trading systems using TypeSafe AI's Jev for typed market and pre-trade decisions; inclusion does not establish profitability.

## Jev Trading Summary

Jev is TypeSafe AI's first public System One model. It returns typed probabilistic decisions rather than free-form trading instructions. Listed implementations use it for bounded choices such as buy/sell/hold, quote direction, technical assessments, or pre-trade gates. The surrounding application remains responsible for market data, arithmetic, sizing, risk limits, credentials, and order execution.

The directory currently compares jev-trader, jev-trade, Jev Trades, Jev A-Share Trader, AI Hedge Fund, and QuantDinger. Dedicated projects default to dry-run, paper, or research modes where documented. No listing establishes profitable performance.
- Broker & Exchange Integrations: official broker and quant-platform MCP services, including Alpaca, Interactive Brokers, QuantConnect, and Robinhood.
- MCP Servers & Agent Skills: tool integrations and skills for supported clients, including Injective, deBridge, and OpenClaw.
- Prediction Markets: Polymarket, Kalshi, multi-venue agents, CLIs, SDKs, and simulation tools.
- Research & Backtesting: financial research agents, automated quantitative R&D, strategy engines, and backtest/paper/live runtimes.
- Data, Wallets & Risk Infrastructure: market data, MPC agent wallets, execution controls, identity, and payments.

## Interpretation

Account eligibility, venue availability, and data access vary. Research, backtesting, paper trading, dry-run, and live execution are distinct modes. Listings are not performance endorsements. New reviewed data entries include license sources and documentation-review dates; missing metadata on older entries means not reviewed. The JSON file is a featured subset, not the entire directory.
